package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	StudentOnboardingTurnSchema              = "student-onboarding-turn.v2"
	StudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema        = "student-onboarding-turn-result.v2"
	StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProofSchema = "student-onboarding-turn-no-effect-proof.v2"
	AuthenticatedUILocaleDefaultRule         = "authenticated_ui_locale.v1"
)

// StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin records why Student accepts a typed value. It is
// deliberately not an LLM output type: Student validates both the origin and
// the value before committing an effect.
type StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin string

const (
	StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitUI   StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin = "explicit_ui"
	StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin = "explicit_text"
	StudentOnboardingTurnOriginInferred     StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin = "inferred"
	StudentOnboardingTurnOriginDefault      StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin = "default"
)

type StudentOnboardingTurnEffectState string

const (
	StudentOnboardingTurnEffectAccepted StudentOnboardingTurnEffectState = "accepted"
	StudentOnboardingTurnEffectNoEffect StudentOnboardingTurnEffectState = "no_effect"
)

const (
	StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode          = "direction_code"
	StudentOnboardingSlotSelfAssessedExperience = "self_assessed_experience"
	StudentOnboardingSlotKnownStacks            = "known_stacks"
	StudentOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks          = "desired_stacks"
	StudentOnboardingSlotGoalCode               = "goal_code"
	StudentOnboardingSlotGoalText               = "goal_text"
	StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage      = "preferred_language"
	StudentOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes          = "weekly_minutes"
	StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredPace          = "preferred_pace"
)

var studentOnboardingTurnSlotOrder = map[string]int{
	StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode:          0,
	StudentOnboardingSlotSelfAssessedExperience: 1,
	StudentOnboardingSlotKnownStacks:            2,
	StudentOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:          3,
	StudentOnboardingSlotGoalCode:               4,
	StudentOnboardingSlotGoalText:               5,
	StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage:      6,
	StudentOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:          7,
	StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredPace:          8,
}

// StudentOnboardingTurnSlot is a closed typed union. Exactly the value field
// associated with SlotCode is populated after NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn.
// It intentionally contains neither map nor json.RawMessage.
type StudentOnboardingTurnSlot struct {
	SlotCode     string                      `json:"slot_code"`
	CodeValue    *string                     `json:"code_value,omitempty"`
	TextValue    *string                     `json:"text_value,omitempty"`
	StacksValue  *[]string                   `json:"stacks_value,omitempty"`
	IntegerValue *int                        `json:"integer_value,omitempty"`
	Origin       StudentOnboardingTurnOrigin `json:"origin"`
	// ConfidenceBasisPoints is the finite deterministic representation of the
	// advisory [0,1] range: 0..10000; explicit UI must be exactly 10000.
	ConfidenceBasisPoints *int    `json:"confidence_basis_points,omitempty"`
	DefaultRuleCode       *string `json:"default_rule_code,omitempty"`
}

// StudentOnboardingTurnCommand is the bounded authoritative write request from
// trusted Teacher. It has no public transport and no field accepting LLM JSON.
type StudentOnboardingTurnCommand struct {
	Schema                    string                      `json:"schema"`
	StudentID                 string                      `json:"-"`
	StudentCommandID          string                      `json:"student_command_id"`
	DialogID                  string                      `json:"dialog_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID         string                      `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	TeacherTurnSequence       int64                       `json:"teacher_turn_sequence"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string                      `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
	ActionReceiptID           *string                     `json:"action_receipt_id,omitempty"`
	SourceEventID             string                      `json:"source_event_id"`
	DialogCausationID         string                      `json:"dialog_causation_id"`
	TeacherJobID              string                      `json:"teacher_job_id"`
	AIExecutionID             *string                     `json:"ai_execution_id,omitempty"`
	CorrelationID             string                      `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID               string                      `json:"causation_id"`
	ExpectedDraftVersion      int64                       `json:"expected_draft_version"`
	ExpectedProfileVersion    *int64                      `json:"expected_profile_version,omitempty"`
	FinalizeCurrentV1         bool                        `json:"finalize_current_v1"`
	Slots                     []StudentOnboardingTurnSlot `json:"slots"`
	RequestHash               string                      `json:"-"`
	OccurredAt                time.Time                   `json:"-"`
}

// StudentOnboardingTurnResult is deliberately a narrow recovery receipt: it
// never exposes a message body, UI payload, LLM output, draft, or profile.
type StudentOnboardingTurnResult struct {
	Schema                    string                           `json:"schema"`
	StudentCommandID          string                           `json:"student_command_id"`
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string                           `json:"canonical_student_message_id"`
	StudentEffectState        StudentOnboardingTurnEffectState `json:"student_effect_state"`
	ResultDraftVersion        *int64                           `json:"result_draft_version,omitempty"`
	ResultProfileVersion      *int64                           `json:"result_profile_version,omitempty"`
	NoEffectProofID           *string                          `json:"no_effect_proof_id,omitempty"`
	Replayed                  bool                             `json:"replayed"`
}

// StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof fences a delayed apply after a failed
// upstream turn. An unknown command is not a proof; it must be inserted under
// the exact command/canonical-message locks by Student.
type StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof struct {
	Schema     string                       `json:"schema"`
	Command    StudentOnboardingTurnCommand `json:"command"`
	OccurredAt time.Time                    `json:"-"`
}

func NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(input StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (StudentOnboardingTurnCommand, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	var err error
	for _, target := range []*string{
		&input.StudentID, &input.StudentCommandID, &input.DialogID, &input.PersonalTeacherID,
		&input.CanonicalStudentMessageID, &input.SourceEventID, &input.DialogCausationID,
		&input.TeacherJobID, &input.CorrelationID, &input.CausationID,
	} {
		if *target, err = canonicalOnboardingTurnUUID(*target); err != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if input.Schema != StudentOnboardingTurnSchema || input.TeacherTurnSequence <= 0 ||
		input.ExpectedDraftVersion < 0 || input.DialogCausationID != input.CanonicalStudentMessageID || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.ExpectedProfileVersion != nil && *input.ExpectedProfileVersion < 0 {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.FinalizeCurrentV1 != (input.ExpectedProfileVersion != nil) {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if !input.FinalizeCurrentV1 && len(input.Slots) == 0 || len(input.Slots) > len(studentOnboardingTurnSlotOrder) {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.FinalizeCurrentV1 && input.ExpectedDraftVersion == 0 {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.ActionReceiptID != nil {
		value, uuidErr := canonicalOnboardingTurnUUID(*input.ActionReceiptID)
		if uuidErr != nil || input.AIExecutionID != nil || input.CorrelationID != value || input.CausationID != input.TeacherJobID {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
		}
		input.ActionReceiptID = &value
	} else {
		if input.AIExecutionID == nil {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
		}
		value, uuidErr := canonicalOnboardingTurnUUID(*input.AIExecutionID)
		if uuidErr != nil || input.CorrelationID != input.CanonicalStudentMessageID || input.CausationID != value {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
		}
		input.AIExecutionID = &value
	}
	if input.ActionReceiptID != nil && input.AIExecutionID != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Slots))
	for index := range input.Slots {
		normalized, err := normalizeStudentOnboardingTurnSlot(input.Slots[index], input.ActionReceiptID != nil)
		if err != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seen[normalized.SlotCode]; exists {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{}, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[normalized.SlotCode] = struct{}{}
		input.Slots[index] = normalized
	}
	sort.Slice(input.Slots, func(i, j int) bool {
		return studentOnboardingTurnSlotOrder[input.Slots[i].SlotCode] < studentOnboardingTurnSlotOrder[input.Slots[j].SlotCode]
	})
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof(input StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	if input.Schema != StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProofSchema || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Command.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentOnboardingTurn(input.Command)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Command = normalized
	return input, nil
}

func (input StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) DraftAnswerPatch() (StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers, error) {
	var answers StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers
	for _, slot := range input.Slots {
		switch slot.SlotCode {
		case StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode:
			answers.DirectionCode = slot.CodeValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotSelfAssessedExperience:
			answers.SelfAssessedExperience = slot.CodeValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotKnownStacks:
			answers.KnownStacks = slot.StacksValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
			answers.DesiredStacks = slot.StacksValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotGoalCode:
			answers.GoalCode = slot.CodeValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotGoalText:
			answers.GoalText = slot.TextValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage:
			answers.PreferredLanguage = slot.CodeValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
			answers.WeeklyMinutes = slot.IntegerValue
		case StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredPace:
			answers.PreferredPace = slot.CodeValue
		default:
			return StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(answers)
}

func normalizeStudentOnboardingTurnSlot(input StudentOnboardingTurnSlot, deterministicAction bool) (StudentOnboardingTurnSlot, error) {
	input.SlotCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.SlotCode)
	if _, known := studentOnboardingTurnSlotOrder[input.SlotCode]; !known {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, errors.New("unknown onboarding turn slot")
	}
	switch input.Origin {
	case StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitUI:
		if !deterministicAction || input.ConfidenceBasisPoints == nil || *input.ConfidenceBasisPoints != 10000 || input.DefaultRuleCode != nil {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrValidation
		}
	case StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText:
		if deterministicAction || input.DefaultRuleCode != nil || input.ConfidenceBasisPoints == nil || *input.ConfidenceBasisPoints < 0 || *input.ConfidenceBasisPoints > 10000 {
			return StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		// inferred remains proposal-only and default needs authenticated locale
		// evidence not introduced by S3.
		return StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, errors.New("invalid onboarding turn origin")
	}
	valueCount := 0
	if input.CodeValue != nil {
		valueCount++
	}
	if input.TextValue != nil {
		valueCount++
	}
	if input.StacksValue != nil {
		valueCount++
	}
	if input.IntegerValue != nil {
		valueCount++
	}
	if valueCount != 1 {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	answers, err := (StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{Slots: []StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{input}}).DraftAnswerPatch()
	if err != nil || !hasDraftAnswers(answers) {
		return StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	// Reuse the draft normalizer's exact bounded values; this avoids a second
	// semantic validator for the same Student-owned fields.
	switch input.SlotCode {
	case StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode:
		input.CodeValue = answers.DirectionCode
	case StudentOnboardingSlotSelfAssessedExperience:
		input.CodeValue = answers.SelfAssessedExperience
	case StudentOnboardingSlotKnownStacks:
		input.StacksValue = answers.KnownStacks
	case StudentOnboardingSlotDesiredStacks:
		input.StacksValue = answers.DesiredStacks
	case StudentOnboardingSlotGoalCode:
		input.CodeValue = answers.GoalCode
	case StudentOnboardingSlotGoalText:
		input.TextValue = answers.GoalText
	case StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredLanguage:
		input.CodeValue = answers.PreferredLanguage
	case StudentOnboardingSlotWeeklyMinutes:
		input.IntegerValue = answers.WeeklyMinutes
	case StudentOnboardingSlotPreferredPace:
		input.CodeValue = answers.PreferredPace
	}
	return input, nil
}

func canonicalOnboardingTurnUUID(value string) (string, error) {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}
